description: This file defines common UI widgets and themes for a Flutter application, including a custom theme, scaffold, and empty state widget.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: Provides theme data, color palette, and gradient background for the app.

classes.name: OceanScaffold
classes.description: A container widget that wraps a Scaffold with custom decoration and layout, including optional action buttons and floating action button.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget displaying an empty state with icon, title, subtitle, and optional action button.

methods.name: themeData
methods.description: Returns a customized ThemeData object configured with Ocean theme colors and styles.

methods.name: softGradientBackground
methods.description: Provides a BoxDecoration with a blue-to-gray linear gradient background.
